title: Lysis of Aspergillus niger for DNA Extraction and Purification
author: Laure Leynaud-Kieffer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wcbfasn

steps.title: Inoculate Aspergillus niger
steps.instruction: Inoculate the strain to be analyzed on Minimal Media Agar (MMA) at 30°C.

substeps.instruction: Perform inoculation 4 days before the lysis.

steps.title: Prepare Biomass and Spore Solution
steps.instruction: Harvest biomass from the slants and prepare a spore solution.

substeps.instruction: Back up the strain by harvesting spores into a new slant (incubate at 30°C for 4 days) before using the entire slant for lysis.
Add 1 mL of 0.2% tween-20 into the slant and vortex to bring spores into solution.

steps.title: Perform First Lysis
steps.instruction: Lysis the mycelia using the 1st lysis buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL of mycelia into 480 µL of 1st lysis buffer (400 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0, 60 mM EDTA pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, and 1% (v/v) SDS).
Mix the total volume of 500 µL and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Second Lysis and Clarification
steps.instruction: Precipitate contaminants using the 2nd buffer and clarify the lysate.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 2nd buffer (2 M potassium acetate and 7.6% glacial acetic at pH 4.8) until the solution turns white opaque.
Transfer 500 µL of the supernatant to a new 1.5-mL Eppendorf tube and centrifuge again for 2 minutes at 10,000 rpm.

steps.title: Wash and Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Purify the DNA using isopropyl alcohol and ethanol washes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL of the supernatant to a new 1.5-mL Eppendorf tube.
Wash with 400 µL of isopropyl alcohol (>99%), invert the tube several times, and centrifuge for 2 minutes at 10,000 rpm.
Discard the supernatant and rinse the DNA pellet with 300 µL 70% EtOH.
Invert the tube several times and centrifuge for 2 minutes at 10,000 rpm.

steps.title: Evaporate and Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Remove residual ethanol and resuspend the purified DNA.

substeps.instruction: Evaporate the remaining EtOH using a rotavapor (30°C, Alcohol mode, 1h 15min).
Dilute the evaporated DNA in 50 µL of dH2O.
